course.title: Observational Cosmology
course.description: Observational foundations of modern cosmology, including supernovae, BAO, the CMB, weak lensing, growth, parameter inference, and survey systematics.

status.reviewStatus: Approved for review release; not yet approved for instructional use

cadence.rationale: Each lab and problem set spans two lecture modules and is due at the end of the second week: Weeks 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, and 14.

dataProvenance.level1: Pantheon+SH0ES public table and full covariance fetched and hashed during production; an 18-row redshift-stratified excerpt and exactly aligned covariance block are included.
dataProvenance.level2: Planck 2018, BOSS DR12, and DES Y3 published summary values; not raw survey likelihoods. Individual references and verification limits are in reference-log.md.
dataProvenance.level3: FLRW/growth model curves, synthetic parameter ellipses, theoretical CMB schematic, and schematic error-budget weights; none are observations.
